svg.title: Ethereal layer · original spire lattice
svg.desc: Reference ethereal map with sixty-one spires on a complete spacing-six lattice including one at the origin.
svg.text: Reproduction of the supplied layout · hex rings 0–24 · every cell is one ethereal hex
Reference extent follows the supplied image. Every sixth coordinate forms the retained spire lattice.
The proposed plan removes the origin spire and adds six gateways on ethereal ring 2.
